The limits only stop it from growing (about a tenth of room); the aim is to bring the figure down, and to lower the limits with it. Lowered from 1150 and 580 the same day, when pictures of places left behind began to rest (world/phonetex.js): 928 MB in all (71 canvases, 394 on the card with a peak of 405, 463 heap). What is left over DRIVE is mostly heap (+190) and model buffers (+80). The total lowered again from 1010 that afternoon, when the parked car models stopped holding their pictures as pixels (world/parked.js keepPacked, 50 MB): 867 MB in all. And from 945 when their detailed models were indexed in the worker and let their arrays go once on the card (76 MB of corners down to 20): 798 MB in all.
